title: PR #39: fix(l1): centralize chain id and verify wallet transfer e2e
content:
State: closed
Merged: True
Draft: False

## Summary
- centralize the numeric A-TownChain Chain-ID in the canonical blockchain kernel
- make atc-node and atc-wallet consume the same Chain-ID constant
- update the wallet→node→mempool→block→state→balance process E2E to use that canonical identity
- remove the stale wallet example value `chain_id: 1`

## Verification
GitHub Actions must pass before treating wallet transfers as CI-verified.

This change does not claim wallet ownership/address binding or production readiness; those remain separate security/integration gates.
